semantics: Exact existing ordered headers; finite nonnegative money in ordinary decimal cents, no exponents; identifiers unique and bounded; source metadata counts/hashes/size checked against actual bytes/rows.
All customer/parent/history/grant/payment joins, recorded-date windows and known account lifecycle boundaries validated. Unknown opening stays unknown, never inferred active.

Payment plan amount = instalment * positive n_instalments. Active/terminal parent state and history agree; every begun parent has one complete active interval and ended parents have one terminal event.
Grant paid amount <= declared application debt and cap, paid date >= application and within accepted hardship interval; paid grants match exactly one cleared P_<grant_id> payment.
Complete synthetic source tables is an uploader declaration plus internal consistency checks, not independently proven real-world completeness. No missing financial input counts as zero.
No complete-daily-usage requirement or bill/debt reconciliation claim for sparse Q3 data. No individual risk or future account prediction.
workflow: Existing stage -> status -> review -> explicit Replace; atomic last-good retention/restart and stale-generation rejection. All four old pinned packages stay accepted unchanged.
generatorAction: Add only the two new manifest fields; keep existing CSV schemas, deterministic gzip and measured size validation. Supply at least two distinct fresh seeds for consumer tests. No live replacement.
